description: Explicit physical mapping between project engineering fields and empirical breach model variables

variable_mappings.engineering_definition: Volume of water above breach bottom elevation at time of failure
variable_mappings.notes: Live storage volume used as initial estimate in absence of dynamic stage-storage routing

variable_mappings.engineering_definition: Height of breach from top of dam to breach bottom
variable_mappings.notes: Assumes hypothetical complete vertical scour to riverbed foundation level

variable_mappings.engineering_definition: Factor for failure mode (1.0 for piping/prescribed, 1.3 for overtopping)
variable_mappings.notes: Prescribed breach scenario uses K_0 = 1.0; overtopping K_0 = 1.3 is not used

variable_mappings.engineering_definition: Breach formation factor (volume times water depth above invert)
variable_mappings.notes: Used to predict volume of eroded material V_er and time t_f. Width calculation requires embankment cross-section geometry.

variable_mappings.engineering_definition: Depth of water above breach invert at failure
variable_mappings.notes: Full depth 105 ft = 32.004 m used; combined with C_b = 54.9 m for large reservoirs
